option.file_source_info:
Select game resource source platform and server region 
- Windows Global (Local) 
- Windows Japan (Local) 
- Android Global (ADB) 
- Android Japan (ADB)
option.crc_correction_info:
Corrects the CRC checksum of bundle files to prevent the 'Abnormal Client' error after modification.
This option must be enabled for the Steam version; it is not required for mobile versions.
When set to 'Auto', the tool will determine if it's needed based on the target bundle's platform info.
option.extra_bytes_info:
Data to append before CRC correction.
Starts with 0x for hex (e.g., 0x0808), otherwise ASCII string (e.g., AB). Leave empty to disable.
option.backup_info: Creates a backup before replacing files.
option.compression_method_info:
Sets the compression method for AssetBundle files.
- LZMA: Highest compression ratio
- LZ4: Medium compression ratio
- Original: Same as the target file
- None: No compression
option.skip_unchanged_info: Do not output files when target content is unchanged
option.replace_texture_info: Image resource files, including character art, model textures, etc.
option.replace_textasset_info: .skel and .atlas files, related to Spine animations.
option.replace_all_info:
Replaces resources of all types.
Experimental, not recommended.
option.spine_conversion_info:
(Optional Extension)
Calls an external program to convert .skel files to a supported version.
Requires configuring the path to the Skel Converter.
option.spine_downgrade_info:
(Optional Extension)
Calls an external program to export files compatible with older Spine versions (.skel and .atlas).
Requires configuring the path to the Skel Converter.
option.scale_atlas_info:
Advanced Option
When downgrading Spine, decides whether to scale images according to the scale factor in the Atlas file.

Enable scaling: Automatically resizes images to match dimensions, allowing direct import into Spine, but may cause precision loss and misalignment. In-game rendering will also use the scaled images, resulting in reduced precision.
Disable scaling (default): Preserves original precision, provides the best in-game rendering, and is recommended for game import. However, when importing into Spine, region attachments will not change size, requiring manual application of the scale factor to the bone's Transform.

The scaling option affects both in-game rendering and Spine import: when disabled, in-game appears normal and Spine requires manual adjustment; when enabled, images are physically scaled, in-game will also show the scaled effect (with precision loss), and Spine needs no manual adjustment.
For importing into Spine, advanced users are recommended to use the no-scaling approach + manually set scale for bones/parts based on the scale factor for the best result.
option.unpack_atlas_info:
Unpacks Atlas into individual PNG frames.
Unpacked frames will be saved in an images/ subdirectory.
option.game_dir_windows_global_info:
Installation directory for the Steam version (Global server)
The program can automatically detect the following subdirectories:
- BlueArchive_Data/StreamingAssets/PUB/Resource/GameData/Windows
- BlueArchive_Data/StreamingAssets/PUB/Resource/Preload/Windows
- GameData/Windows
- Preload/Windows
option.game_dir_windows_japan_info: Installation directory for the PC version (Japan server)
option.game_dir_android_global_info:
Game resource directory on Android device (Global server)
e.g.: /storage/emulated/0/Android/data/com.nexon.bluearchive/files/
option.game_dir_android_japan_info:
Game resource directory on Android device (Japan server)
e.g.: /storage/emulated/0/Android/data/com.Yostar JP.BlueArchive/files/
option.language_info:
Program language.
Restart the program after changing to take effect.
option.output_dir_info: Output directory for files generated by the program.
option.check_animations_info:
When replacing .skel files, detect whether the target contains animations not present in the source
Requires configuring the SpineViewerCLI path
option.match_strategy_info:
Select the strategy for matching resources:
- path_id: Best for same-version files, exact match
- cont_name_type: Best for cross-version migration (between Global and Japanese servers) with container+name+type matching
- name_type: name+type matching
option.enable_bleed_info:
Applies bleed operations to image files.
Recommended if packed images show black or jagged edges in-game.
option.enable_spine38_name_fix_info:
Rename the filename format exported by older Spine versions to the new format.
Example: CH0808_home2.png → CH0808_home_2.png
option.enable_spine_preview_info:
Generate preview images for Spine assets (requires SpineViewerCLI path to be configured)

Note: this feature can take a long time.
option.extractor_render_preview_info:
Render preview images for the extracted Spine assets after extraction (requires SpineViewerCLI path to be configured).
Previews directly reuse the extracted files without re-extracting.

Note: if Atlas unpacking is also enabled, previews for some assets may fail to generate.
option.report_format_info:
Choose the report output format:
- List: one item per line, good for quick browsing
- Table: Markdown table, recommended when rendering preview images
option.report_render_preset_info:
Select the rendering quality of preview images.
Higher quality may take longer to render.
option.max_workers_info:
Number of mod files processed simultaneously.

Increasing the number increases processing speed but increases memory usage.
option.character_id_map_info: Character ID to name mapping table, used to display actual character names for files.
option.character_index_column_info:
The column in the mapping CSV used as the lookup key (character internal ID).
Key values should look like CH0808.
option.character_name_field_info:
Select the display field for character names:
full_name: kivo.wiki (Chinese, Most Complete)
name_cn: Chinese Mainland Server
name_jp: Japanese
name_tw: Traditional Chinese
name_en: English
name_kr: Korean

The English and Korean versions contain only the character names, while the JP, CN, TW versions also include the names of the characters' costume variants (e.g., Swimsuit, Maid, etc.). The kivo.wiki version additionally includes names for more NPC variants (e.g., Sportswear, Unarmed, etc.).
option.adb_path_info: Full path to adb.exe, or "adb" to use system PATH
option.adb_cache_dir_info: Local cache directory for ADB files
option.backup_path_info: Choose the directory where backup files will be saved

tools.batch_tools_info:
Mod detection method: compares the size recorded in the bundle file header with the actual file size. If extra trailing bytes are appended to the file, it is identified as a mod. The batch tools below all rely on this detection.

Note: this detection method is only guaranteed to work on the Steam version. Mods for other versions can enter the game without CRC correction, so detection is not guaranteed for them.

report.title: Generate Mod Report
report.info: Scan all detected mod files in the game directory and generate a Markdown report grouped by category. Optionally render Spine preview images.

abnormal_check.title: Fix "Abnormal Client"
abnormal_check.info: Detect mod files whose filename CRC does not match the actual file CRC (such files are flagged as abnormal by the game client), and fix them with one click.

backup.title: Backup Mods
backup.info: Copy all detected mod files in the game directory to the specified backup directory, preserving the original directory structure.
